agent_explanation: Cruise-phase controller output is correctly clamped at fmax (steps 11-13 force exactly 11.346). At step 14 the hover body arrives within ~1m of its waypoint (17.35,10.16 vs 18.1,10.8) at ~50 m/s while vcmd is 12.4. The arrival/braking law then commands ~580 N, ~51x fmax, bypassing the fmax clamp applied in cruise. Likely cause: separate waypoint-capture / stopping branch that omits the force-saturation step.
